title: EvoCorps: An Evolutionary Multi-Agent Framework for Depolarizing Online Discourse

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying the intensity of user opinions by classifying comments into five ordered levels (from "Very Moderate" to "Very Extreme") using an LLM-based grader to measure ideological polarization.

Assessing affective bias by measuring the sentiment of user comments on a five-level scale (using an LLM) and detecting toxicity (using the Perspective API) to evaluate emotional regulation and hostility.
Evaluating cognitive and argumentative biases by detecting logical fallacies (e.g., Ad Hominem, False Cause) and scoring argument quality and evidence usage in user comments using LLM-based rubrics.
